caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a lidded pitcher or tankard, outlined in black ink on a plain, off-white background. The pitcher has a bulbous body that tapers inward towards the top and bottom, sitting on a pedestal base with layered, horizontal lines. The lid of the pitcher is domed and topped with a finial, which is a decorative pointed ornament. A large, curved handle is attached to one side, starting near the rim and connecting to the lower middle section of the pitcher, with a small decorative thumb rest and a hooked end at the bottom. Near the top of the body, there is a small label-like area with the word "Cheltenham" inscribed inside. The overall composition is centered on the page, and the artist's signature, "Lawrence Flynn," is present in the lower right corner. The lines are clean and precise, and there is no shading or color filling; the entire drawing consists of fine black lines on a lightly yellowed paper.
title: Silver Flagon
